name: nanos world - Latest
author: contact@velyorix.com
description: Open-source Pelican egg for nanos world Dedicated Server. CLI arguments validated against nanos world a1.156.0 documentation; SteamCMD public/bleeding-edge install, safe startup wrapper and game/query allocations.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-1936830}"
BRANCH="${SRCDS_BETAID:-public}"
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
STEAMCMD_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}/steamcmd"

echo "=================================================="
echo " nanos world Dedicated Server - Pelican"
echo " Maintainer: Yuketsu (YuketsuSh)"
echo " Steam App ID: ${APP_ID}"
echo " Branch: ${BRANCH}"
echo "=================================================="

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}" "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
cd /tmp

echo "[1/4] Downloading SteamCMD..."
curl -fsSL \
  "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" \
  -o steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd_linux.tar.gz -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

export HOME="${INSTALL_DIR}"
cd "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

echo "[2/4] Installing/updating nanos world..."
./steamcmd.sh \
    +force_install_dir "${INSTALL_DIR}" \
    +login anonymous \
    +app_update "${APP_ID}" -beta "${BRANCH}" validate \
    +quit

echo "[3/4] Preparing Steam runtime..."
mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"

if [[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" \
        "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
fi

if [[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" \
        "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
fi

chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "[4/4] Writing Pelican startup wrapper..."

cat > "${INSTALL_DIR}/pelican-start.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /home/container

if [[ ! -f "./NanosWorldServer.sh" ]]; then
    echo "[FATAL] ./NanosWorldServer.sh was not found."
    echo "[FATAL] Reinstall the server from Pelican."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x ./NanosWorldServer.sh 2>/dev/null || true

if [[ "${QUERY_PORT}" == "${SERVER_PORT}" ]]; then
    echo "[FATAL] QUERY_PORT (${QUERY_PORT}) must differ from SERVER_PORT (${SERVER_PORT})."
    exit 1
fi

if (( MAX_FILE_TRANSFER_RATE > MAX_SEND_RATE )); then
    echo "[WARN] MAX_FILE_TRANSFER_RATE is greater than MAX_SEND_RATE."
    echo "[WARN] nanos world will clamp it; using MAX_SEND_RATE=${MAX_SEND_RATE} instead."
    MAX_FILE_TRANSFER_RATE="${MAX_SEND_RATE}"
fi

args=(
    --name "${SERVER_NAME}"
    --description "${SERVER_DESCRIPTION}"
    --ip "0.0.0.0"
    --port "${SERVER_PORT}"
    --query_port "${QUERY_PORT}"
    --announce "${ANNOUNCE}"
    --dedicated_server "${DEDICATED_SERVER}"
    --steam_app "${STEAM_APP}"
    --map "${SERVER_MAP}"
    --max_players "${MAX_PLAYERS}"
    --async_log "${ASYNC_LOG}"
    --log_level "${LOG_LEVEL}"
    --compression "${COMPRESSION}"
    --max_tick_rate "${MAX_TICK_RATE}"
    --max_sync_rate "${MAX_SYNC_RATE}"
    --max_send_rate "${MAX_SEND_RATE}"
    --max_file_transfer_rate "${MAX_FILE_TRANSFER_RATE}"
    --distance_optimization "${DISTANCE_OPTIMIZATION}"
    --thread_pool_count "${THREAD_POOL_COUNT}"
)

[[ -n "${SERVER_PASSWORD:-}" ]] && args+=(--password "${SERVER_PASSWORD}")
[[ -n "${SERVER_TOKEN:-}" ]] && args+=(--token "${SERVER_TOKEN}")
[[ -n "${GAME_MODE:-}" ]] && args+=(--game_mode "${GAME_MODE}")
[[ -n "${PACKAGES:-}" ]] && args+=(--packages "${PACKAGES}")
[[ -n "${ASSETS:-}" ]] && args+=(--assets "${ASSETS}")
[[ -n "${LOADING_SCREEN:-}" ]] && args+=(--loading_screen "${LOADING_SCREEN}")
[[ -n "${SERVER_LOGO:-}" ]] && args+=(--logo "${SERVER_LOGO}")
[[ -n "${CUSTOM_SETTINGS:-}" ]] && args+=(--custom_settings "${CUSTOM_SETTINGS}")

[[ "${AUTO_DOWNLOAD:-1}" == "1" ]] && args+=(--auto_download)
[[ "${PROFILING:-0}" == "1" ]] && args+=(--profiling)
[[ "${LOG_SHOW_THREAD:-0}" == "1" ]] && args+=(--log_show_thread)
[[ "${USE_VAULT_ASSETS_LEAN:-0}" == "1" ]] && args+=(--use_vault_assets_lean)
[[ "${ENABLE_UNSAFE_LIBS:-0}" == "1" ]] && args+=(--enable_unsafe_libs)

echo "=================================================="
echo " nanos world Dedicated Server"
echo " Maintained by Yuketsu / YuketsuSh"
echo " Game/HTTP : 0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT} TCP + UDP"
echo " Query     : 0.0.0.0:${QUERY_PORT} UDP"
echo " Steam App : ${STEAM_APP}"
echo " Map       : ${SERVER_MAP}"
echo " Players   : ${MAX_PLAYERS}"
echo "=================================================="

exec ./NanosWorldServer.sh "${args[@]}"
EOF

chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/pelican-start.sh"

echo "Installation completed successfully."

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Official nanos world Dedicated Server Steam App ID.

variables.name: Release Branch
variables.description: Steam branch: public (stable) or bleeding-edge (preview).

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: UDP query allocation. Must differ from SERVER_PORT.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the nanos world server list.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Server-list description. nanos world limits it to 200 characters.
variables.default_value: A nanos world server hosted with Pelican.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional join password.

variables.name: Server Token
variables.description: Optional nanos world authorization token for Vault downloads.

variables.name: Steam App
variables.description: Players must run the same Steam App as the server.

variables.name: Announce Server
variables.description: 1 publishes the server in the master list; 0 enables direct-connect only.

variables.name: Dedicated Server
variables.description: 1 uses dedicated networking; 0 uses Steam Datagram Relay/P2P.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map package loaded at startup.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Optional game-mode package.

variables.name: Packages
variables.description: Optional comma-separated package list.

variables.name: Assets
variables.description: Optional comma-separated Asset Pack list.

variables.name: Loading Screen
variables.description: Optional loading-screen package.

variables.name: Server Logo
variables.description: Optional HTTP(S) image URL used as server logo.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous players (1-999).

variables.name: Auto Download
variables.description: Automatically download missing Vault packages/assets.

variables.name: Async Logging
variables.description: Asynchronous logging. Recommended for production.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: 1 normal, 2 debug, 3 verbose.

variables.name: Compression
variables.description: Network compression: 0 disabled, 1 fastest/default, 9 strongest.

variables.name: Max Tick Rate
variables.description: Server tick rate in Hz. Official default/recommendation: 30.

variables.name: Max Sync Rate
variables.description: Maximum actor synchronization rate in Hz.

variables.name: Max Send Rate
variables.description: Maximum network send rate per client in KB/s. Official default: 1024.

variables.name: Max File Transfer Rate
variables.description: Asset/package transfer rate per client in KB/s; must not exceed Max Send Rate.

variables.name: Distance Optimization
variables.description: 0 disables; 4 is the official balanced default; 9 is most aggressive.

variables.name: Thread Pool Count
variables.description: Async operation worker threads. 0 disables the pool. Default 8 or CPU-core based.

variables.name: Custom Settings
variables.description: Optional TOML-style custom settings, e.g. max_props = 1000, enable_pvp = true

variables.name: Performance Profiling
variables.description: Enable profiling logs for diagnostics.

variables.name: Show Log Thread
variables.description: Show current thread in log output.

variables.name: Vault Lean Assets
variables.description: Download only Asset Pack TOML configuration files from Vault.

variables.name: Unsafe Lua Libraries
variables.description: DANGEROUS: enables unsafe Lua OS/file APIs. Keep disabled unless explicitly required.
